mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_activities (user_id, activity_type, trip_plan_id, trip_plan_title, place_name, visit_day) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityType}, #{tripPlanId}, #{tripPlanTitle}, #{placeName}, #{visitDay})
mapper.select: SELECT ua.id, ua.user_id, ua.activity_type, ua.trip_plan_id, COALESCE(tp.title, ua.trip_plan_title) AS trip_plan_title, ua.place_name, ua.visit_day, ua.created_at FROM user_activities ua LEFT JOIN trip_plans tp ON tp.id = ua.trip_plan_id WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ua.created_at DESC, ua.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
